description: Assemble the /showcase page and wire up everything: create app/showcase/page.tsx (Server Component with metadata export, dynamic-importing all Three.js components with ssr:false), update next.config.ts to add images.qualities, and add a link from app/page.tsx... wait — app/page.tsx must NOT be modified. The showcase is a standalone route. This FEAT wires all components together into the working /showcase page.
steps: Update d:\My-Projects\NEXT\hariswork\next.config.ts to add images: { qualities: [75] } inside the nextConfig object. This is required by Next.js 16 — any quality value not in the allowlist is rejected. Keep all existing experimental flags and turbopack config intact.

Create d:\My-Projects\NEXT\hariswork\app\showcase\page.tsx. This is a Server Component (no 'use client'). Export: export const metadata: Metadata = { title: 'Project Showcase — HarisPortfolio', description: 'A visual tour of MineConnect features, dashboards, and reports.', openGraph: { title: 'HarisPortfolio Showcase', description: 'Feature gallery with screenshots and reports.', type: 'website' } }. Import showcaseItems and GROUP_META from @/data/showcase. Group items by group key. Dynamic imports (all with ssr:false): const Hero = dynamic(() => import('@/components/showcase/Hero'), { ssr: false, loading: () => <div className='animate-pulse bg-zinc-800 h-screen' /> }); same for Gallery3D. Non-Three components imported normally (they are client components but SSR-safe). Page structure: (1) <ScrollProgress /> (2) <GroupNav /> client wrapper that tracks activeGroup via IntersectionObserver scroll-spy on section IDs — since this is a Server Component, GroupNav is driven by a client wrapper component ShowcasePageClient.tsx described next. (3) <Hero /> dynamically imported. (4) For each group: <GroupSection group={g} items={groupedItems[g]} />. (5) <section id='gallery-3d'> with <Gallery3D items={showcaseItems} /> dynamically imported, wrapped in Suspense. (6) Reports section: filter items for group==='reports', render ReportCard for each PDF/PPTX item. (7) Footer CTA: motion.div with contact/link text.

Create d:\My-Projects\NEXT\hariswork\app\showcase\ShowcasePageClient.tsx. 'use client'. This thin client shell handles: (a) scroll-spy via IntersectionObserver watching section#core, #admin, #reports, #mobile — updates activeGroup state. (b) Lightbox state: selectedImages (string[]) and lightboxOpen (boolean), triggered by FeatureCard's onImageClick prop. (c) Renders GroupNav with activeGroup + setter, and AnimatePresence wrapping Lightbox. Props: children (renders the server-rendered GroupSection tree as a slot). GroupSection/FeatureCard emit onImageClick up through a context: create ShowcaseContext (selectedImages, openLightbox). ShowcasePageClient provides ShowcaseContext.Provider. FeatureCard consumes useShowcaseContext() to call openLightbox([...item.images], initialIndex). This avoids prop-drilling through Server Components.

Verify the complete build: run `npx next build` and confirm exit 0, the /showcase route appears in the build output, and there are zero TypeScript errors. Fix any type errors found — common ones: (a) useTexture returning Texture | Texture[] — use Array.isArray check. (b) OrbitControls ref type — import OrbitControls type from three-stdlib. (c) motion values type mismatch — use MotionValue<number> explicitly. (d) Canvas event handler types — use ThreeEvent<PointerEvent> from @react-three/fiber.
acceptance_criteria: app/showcase/page.tsx exports metadata and renders all sections
Hero and Gallery3D are loaded with next/dynamic ssr:false
ShowcasePageClient.tsx handles scroll-spy and lightbox state via React Context
FeatureCard can open Lightbox without prop-drilling through Server Components
`npx next build` exits 0, /showcase route in build output, 0 TypeScript errors
verification: cd d:\My-Projects\NEXT\hariswork && npx next build -- build must complete with exit 0 and /showcase route listed in output
findings: Build completed successfully: compiled in 1372ms, TypeScript check passed in 3.6s, 0 errors, /showcase route emitted as static (○). Key finding: Next.js 16 Turbopack enforces that ssr:false is NOT allowed with next/dynamic in Server Components (breaking change vs prior versions). Fixed by moving all dynamic(ssr:false) calls into ShowcasePageClient.tsx (which is 'use client'). Also: new Date() in a Client Component causes a prerender error — fixed by using useState(null) + useEffect(() => setYear(new Date().getFullYear()), []) in FooterCTA.tsx. Additional files created: app/showcase/ShowcaseContext.tsx (createContext + useShowcaseContext hook), app/showcase/FooterCTA.tsx (client component with Framer Motion), FeatureCard.tsx updated to consume useShowcaseContext and wire image clicks to openLightbox. Shell tool reports exit -1 for all commands on Windows cmd — this is a tool artifact; actual build success confirmed via background process and reading build-v3.txt which shows EXIT_0.
